identity.problem_source: T4 baseline case T1-INC-14 is missed because a Markdown receipt without a SUMMARY-GUARD block skips silently.

selection_rationale: This is a repeated, deterministic development miss from the T4 case-level baseline, not a manufactured improvement target. It has two identical replay logs and a precise entrypoint semantics statement.

entries.intent: Preserve the existing positive control for a Markdown receipt block whose declared artifact hash matches.
Preserve the runtime-only mismatch negative control and require target guard exit code 1.

entries.future_authorization_note: The closed T5 vocabulary has no no-receipt-block enum or canonical absence code. T6 does not modify the shared registry; T7 may evaluate this entry only after a separately reviewed operation extension.
entries.intent: Require rejection when the evidence Markdown has no receipt block, rather than silent success.

parameterization.required_result: REJECT with an explicit missing-receipt-block code

six_gate_targets.severe_defect_miss: T1-INC-14 target 0/1 from measured baseline 1/1 missed.
six_gate_targets.legitimate_false_block: No target increase; positive control must remain ACCEPT.
six_gate_targets.evidence_completeness: Target 100% for required receipt-block presence on the paired fixture.
six_gate_targets.claim_overreach: No new scientific or runtime claim; remains COMPONENT-level evidence.
six_gate_targets.raw_record_integrity: No fixture overwrite; runtime-only mismatch remains outside the package.

evaluation_plan.executor: T7 only; not executed in T6.
evaluation_plan.design: Paired baseline-versus-candidate measurement on one absent-block negative, one matching positive, and one runtime-only mismatch negative.
evaluation_plan.primary_metric: Absent-block severe miss changes from 1/1 to 0/1.
regression_metrics: Mismatching positive remains rejected by target guard exit code 1.
No target execution occurs before fail-closed validation.
frozen_inputs: T4 summary guard and derive adapters
evaluation_plan.stopping_rule: NO_ENABLED_CANDIDATE if the future operation extension is not separately authorized or any hard gate regresses.

cost_record.note: T6 is offline proposal construction only; T7 cost is projected but not spent.

version_applicability.applies_to: Evidence-delivery recipes over the unchanged T4 summary guard and the T5 closed R vocabulary.
reopen_conditions: A separately authorized registered operation can parameterize and reject an absent receipt block.
A new parent content group changes guard entrypoint semantics.
Independent evidence shows the absence family differs from the T4 case.
